title: Alkaline-SDS Cell Lysis of Microbes for Proteomic Sample Preparation
author: Yan Chen
materials: Start with 10 µL of cells per well a non-skirted PCR plate (Thermo Scientific, Cat.#AB0600). Plate of cell pellets When processing larger amounts of biomass increase reagent volumes accordingly. This protocol works in larger formats (e.g., 1.7 mL Eppendorf tubes) too.

steps.title: Resuspend cell pellet in lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in lysis buffer using a plate mixer, ensuring thorough mixing of buffer and pellet.

steps.title: Add hydrochloric acid
steps.instruction: Add 2.75 µL of 1 M hydrochloric acid (Sigma Cat.#320331) to each well.

steps.title: Add ammonium bicarbonate and benzonase
steps.instruction: Add 25 µL of 100 mM ammonium bicarbonate (VWR Scientific Cat.#BJ40867-50G) and 0.5 µL of Benzonase nuclease (Millipore Cat.#70746) to each well.

steps.title: Mix lysate thoroughly
steps.instruction: Mix the contents thoroughly on the plate mixer.

steps.title: Precipitate proteins with acetone
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL of 100 % acetone (Sigma Cat.#179124) to each well and let stand at room temperature for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Resuspend protein pellet in buffer
steps.instruction: Add 60 µL of 100 mM ammonium bicarbonate in 10 % methanol to each well to resuspend the protein pellet.

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Carefully remove and discard the supernatant, leaving the protein pellet behind.

steps.title: Wash protein pellet with acetone
steps.instruction: Wash the protein pellet twice with 150 µL of 80 % acetone (Sigma Cat.#179124). Increase the number of washes if the sample matrix background requires it.

substeps.instruction: Add 150 µL 80 % acetone, then discard the supernatant (first wash).
Repeat the addition of 150 µL 80 % acetone and discard supernatant (second wash).

steps.title: Store pellet at -20°C
steps.instruction: Store the washed pellet at –20 °C until ready for automated protein quantitation with the Biomek‑FX liquid handler system.

steps.title: Add alkaline SDS lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Add 25 µL of alkaline‑SDS cell lysis buffer (200 mM NaOH, 1 % SDS) to each well.
